quiz_questions: Why is the real-time event pipeline explicitly mandated to be built as a separate PBI before any card-based UI functionality is developed?

The project assumes the existing NiceGUI event loop can handle long-lived Supabase Realtime connections. What happens if this assumption proves incorrect, and why does this specific failure necessitate that secondary architectural shift?
quiz_answers: Prioritizing architectural stability over immediate UI feature richness.
The architecture will need to shift to a separate WebSocket gateway for Realtime events.
